data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: new
sections.question: new
sections.summary: made or bought recently; not old

senses.definition: made, bought, or seen for the first time; not old
examples: She bought a new dress for the party.
He got a new phone for his birthday.
